lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Cu10Co4 (reduced formula Mg6Cu5Co2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Co, Cu, and Mg atoms each show 12 geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.70–3.27 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cu-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cu- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
